breakfast.title: Oats with Berries
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Rolled oats (50g)
-  Blueberries (40g)
-  Strawberries (30g)
-  Almond milk (200ml)
-  Chia seeds (1 tsp)
-  Maple syrup (1 tsp)
breakfast.health_benefits: Rich in soluble fiber that lowers cholesterol and stabilizes blood sugar. Berries provide powerful antioxidants. Chia seeds add omega-3 fatty acids for brain health.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Heat the almond milk in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat, bringing it to a gentle, steady simmer over medium heat.
2. Add oats and cook and simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, stirring occasionally.
3. Transfer to a bowl and top with fresh berries.
4. Sprinkle chia seeds and drizzle maple syrup.
5. Transfer to a warmed serving bowl and serve immediately while hot and fresh.

breakfast.title: Banana Almond Smoothie
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Banana (1 large)
-  Almond butter (1 tbsp)
-  Almond milk (200ml)
-  Oats (2 tbsp)
-  Cinnamon (pinch)
-  Ice cubes
breakfast.health_benefits: Bananas are rich in potassium for heart and muscle function. Almond butter provides healthy monounsaturated fats and vitamin E. Quick-digesting energy, perfect for mornings.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Peel and slice the banana.
2. Carefully place the banana, almond butter, milk, oats, and cinnamon into a high-speed countertop blender.
3. Add ice cubes and blend on high for 60 seconds.
4. Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

breakfast.title: Avocado Toast with Seeds
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Sourdough bread (2 slices)
-  Avocado (1/2 ripe)
-  Cherry tomatoes (4)
-  Pumpkin seeds (1 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice (1 tsp)
-  Red pepper flakes
-  Salt & pepper
breakfast.health_benefits: Avocado provides heart-healthy monounsaturated fats and fiber. Sourdough is easier to digest due to fermentation. Pumpkin seeds are rich in zinc and magnesium.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Lightly toast artisan sourdough bread slices in a toaster or on a hot griddle until they are golden-brown, crisp, and warm until golden.
2. In a small bowl, thoroughly mash fresh, ripe avocado flesh with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. using a fork until a spreadable, chunky texture is achieved
3. Evenly spread the seasoned mashed avocado mixture onto the toasted artisan bread slices.
4. Top the dish with a generous layer of halved cherry tomatoes and pumpkin seeds. for added flavor and texture
5. Sprinkle red pepper flakes.

breakfast.title: Overnight Chia Pudding
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Chia seeds (3 tbsp)
-  Coconut milk (200ml)
-  Mango (1/2, diced)
-  Granola (2 tbsp)
-  Maple syrup (1 tsp)
breakfast.health_benefits: Chia seeds are loaded with omega-3 fatty acids and fiber. Coconut milk provides healthy medium-chain fats. Mango is rich in vitamin C and beta-carotene.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Thoroughly combine chia seeds with coconut milk and maple syrup in a glass jar or airtight container and stir well.
2. Stir well and refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).
3. In the morning, top with diced mango and granola.
4. Cover and chill if necessary, then serve cold as a refreshing and nutritious dish.

breakfast.title: Tofu Scramble
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Firm tofu (200g)
-  Turmeric (1/2 tsp)
-  Spinach (40g)
-  Bell pepper (1/4, diced)
-  Onion (1/4, diced)
-  Nutritional yeast (1 tbsp)
-  Olive oil (1 tsp)
breakfast.health_benefits: Tofu provides complete plant-based protein with all essential amino acids. Turmeric has powerful anti-inflammatory properties. Nutritional yeast adds B-vitamins.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Crumble tofu with hands into rough chunks.
2. Heat high-quality extra virgin olive oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat until it begins to shimmer slightly, saute onion and bell pepper 3 mins.
3. Add crumbled tofu and turmeric, cook 5 minutes stirring.
4. Add spinach and nutritional yeast, cook until spinach wilts.
5. Season and serve warm.

breakfast.title: Egg White Omelette
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Egg whites (4)
-  Spinach (30g)
-  Bell pepper (1/4, diced)
-  Mushrooms (3, sliced)
-  Olive oil spray
-  Salt & pepper
breakfast.health_benefits: Ultra-high protein with minimal fat, ideal for muscle building. Spinach adds iron and folate. Very low calorie, perfect for weight loss goals.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Heat a non-stick pan with olive oil spray.
2. saute mushrooms and bell pepper for 2 minutes.
3. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
4. Pour egg whites over vegetables, cook until set.
5. Fold in half and serve.

breakfast.title: Paneer Paratha
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Whole wheat flour (100g)
-  Paneer (80g, crumbled)
-  Green chili (1, minced)
-  Cumin seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Coriander leaves
-  Ghee (1 tbsp)
-  Salt
breakfast.health_benefits: Paneer is rich in calcium and casein protein for slow digestion. Whole wheat provides complex carbs and fiber. A filling, traditional Indian breakfast that sustains energy.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Knead whole wheat dough with water and salt, rest 15 mins.
2. Mix crumbled paneer with chili, cumin, coriander, and salt.
3. Roll dough ball, stuff with paneer mixture, seal and roll flat.
4. Cook on a hot tawa with ghee on both sides until golden.
5. Serve hot with curd or pickle.

breakfast.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Greek yogurt (150g)
-  Granola (30g)
-  Honey (1 tbsp)
-  Mixed berries (50g)
-  Flaxseed (1 tsp)
breakfast.health_benefits: Greek yogurt is rich in probiotics for gut health and protein. Honey has natural antibacterial properties. Flaxseed provides plant-based omega-3s.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Layer Greek yogurt at the bottom of a glass or bowl.
2. Add a layer of granola.
3. Add a layer of mixed berries.
4. Repeat layers.
5. Drizzle honey on top and sprinkle flaxseed.

breakfast.title: Masala Dosa
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Dosa batter (1 ladle)
-  Potato (1, boiled & mashed)
-  Mustard seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Curry leaves (5-6)
-  Turmeric (1/4 tsp)
-  Green chili (1)
-  Oil (1 tsp)
-  Coconut chutney & sambar
breakfast.health_benefits: Fermented batter is excellent for gut health and easier to digest. Potatoes provide vitamin B6 and potassium. A traditional South Indian dish that's light yet filling.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves until they splutter.
2. Add mashed potato, turmeric, chili, and salt. Mix well.
3. Spread dosa batter thin on a hot tawa in a circular motion.
4. Drizzle oil around edges, cook until crisp.
5. Place potato filling in center, fold and serve with chutney & sambar.

breakfast.title: Idli Sambar
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Idli batter (for 4 idlis)
-  Toor dal (50g)
-  Mixed vegetables (carrot, drumstick, beans)
-  Sambar powder (1 tbsp)
-  Tamarind paste (1 tsp)
-  Mustard seeds & curry leaves
-  Coconut chutney
breakfast.health_benefits: Idlis are steamed, making them one of the lightest Indian breakfasts. Fermented batter provides probiotics. Sambar adds protein from lentils and vitamins from vegetables.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Steam idli batter in idli moulds for 10-12 minutes.
2. For sambar: cook toor dal until soft, pressure cook vegetables.
3. Add tamarind paste, sambar powder, and cooked veggies to dal.
4. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
5. Serve idlis hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

breakfast.title: Chicken Sausage Wrap
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Chicken sausages (2)
-  Whole wheat wrap (1)
-  Lettuce (2 leaves)
-  Tomato (1/2, sliced)
-  Mustard sauce (1 tbsp)
-  Cheese slice (1)
breakfast.health_benefits: Good source of lean protein from chicken sausages. Whole wheat wrap adds fiber and complex carbs. A quick, protein-packed breakfast for busy mornings.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Grill or pan-fry chicken sausages until cooked through.
2. Warm the whole wheat wrap on a pan.
3. Layer lettuce, sliced tomato, and cheese on the wrap.
4. Place sausages on top and drizzle mustard sauce.
5. Roll tightly and slice in half.

breakfast.title: Egg Bhurji on Toast
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Eggs (3)
-  Onion (1/2, diced)
-  Tomato (1/2, diced)
-  Green chili (1)
-  Turmeric (1/4 tsp)
-  Whole wheat bread (2 slices)
-  Butter (1 tsp)
-  Coriander leaves
breakfast.health_benefits: Eggs are a complete protein source with all essential amino acids. Rich in choline for brain health. Indian-spiced scramble with anti-inflammatory turmeric.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Heat butter in a pan, saute onion until translucent.
2. Add tomato, green chili, and turmeric. Cook 2 minutes.
3. Beat eggs and pour into pan. Scramble until just set.
4. Garnish with coriander leaves.
5. Toast bread and serve egg bhurji on top.

breakfast.title: Smoked Salmon Toast
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Smoked salmon (80g)
-  Cream cheese (30g)
-  Sourdough bread (2 slices)
-  Capers (1 tsp)
-  Red onion (thin slices)
-  Fresh dill
-  Lemon wedge
breakfast.health_benefits: Salmon is one of the best sources of omega-3 DHA and EPA for brain and heart health. High-quality protein supports muscle maintenance. Anti-inflammatory benefits.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Lightly toast artisan sourdough bread slices in a toaster or on a hot griddle until they are golden-brown, crisp, and warm until golden and crisp.
2. Spread cream cheese evenly on toast.
3. Layer smoked salmon slices on top.
4. Garnish with capers, red onion rings, and fresh dill.
5. Squeeze lemon juice over and serve.

breakfast.title: Turkey Bacon & Eggs
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Turkey bacon (3 strips)
-  Eggs (2)
-  Avocado (1/4)
-  Salt & pepper
-  Olive oil spray
breakfast.health_benefits: Turkey bacon is leaner than regular bacon with less saturated fat. Eggs provide complete protein and choline. Avocado adds heart-healthy monounsaturated fats.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Cook turkey bacon in a pan until crisp, set aside.
2. In the same pan, fry eggs to your preference (sunny side up or scrambled).
3. Slice avocado.
4. Plate eggs with turkey bacon and avocado slices.
5. Season with salt and pepper.

breakfast.title: Poha with Peanuts
breakfast.ingredients:
-  Flattened rice / poha (100g)
-  Peanuts (2 tbsp)
-  Onion (1/2, diced)
-  Mustard seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Curry leaves (5-6)
-  Turmeric (1/4 tsp)
-  Lemon juice (1 tsp)
-  Green chili (1)
-  Coriander leaves
breakfast.health_benefits: Poha is light and easy to digest, rich in iron due to flattened rice. Peanuts add protein and healthy fats. A traditional Indian breakfast that's quick and nutritious.
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Wash poha in water, drain, and set aside.
2. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and peanuts.
3. Add onion and green chili, saute until golden.
4. Add turmeric and drained poha. Mix gently.
5. Squeeze lemon juice, garnish with coriander, and serve.

breakfast.title: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
breakfast.ingredients: Flour, milk, eggs, baking powder, maple syrup, butter
breakfast.recipe_steps: 1. Mix batter. 2. Cook on griddle until bubbly. 3. Serve with syrup.
breakfast.health_benefits: Quick energy source.

breakfast.title: Frittata with Tomatoes & Basil
breakfast.ingredients: Eggs, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, parmesan cheese
breakfast.recipe_steps: 1. Whisk eggs. 2. Pour into pan with tomatoes. 3. Bake until set. 4. Top with basil.
breakfast.health_benefits: High protein, low carb, rich in lycopene.

breakfast.title: Huevos Rancheros

breakfast.health_benefits: Excellent balance of fiber, protein, and healthy fats.

breakfast.title: Congee (Rice Porridge)

breakfast.recipe_steps: 1. Boil rice with extra water until broken down. 2. Garnish with ginger and scallions.
breakfast.health_benefits: Very easy to digest, hydrating, and warming.

breakfast.title: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
breakfast.ingredients: Eggs, whole wheat bread, butter, salt, pepper, chives, cherry tomatoes
breakfast.recipe_steps:

2. Melt butter in a pan on low heat.
3. Pour eggs and gently stir with spatula.
4. Remove while still slightly wet.
5. Serve on toasted bread with chives and tomatoes.
breakfast.health_benefits: Excellent protein source, healthy fats, sustained morning energy.

breakfast.title: Aloo Paratha
breakfast.ingredients: Whole wheat flour, boiled potato, cumin, green chili, coriander, ghee, curd
breakfast.recipe_steps:

3. Stuff dough balls with potato mixture.
4. Roll and cook on tava with ghee.
5. Serve with curd or pickle.
breakfast.health_benefits: Filling and energy-dense, good for active mornings, provides carbs and fats.

breakfast.title: Smoothie Bowl
breakfast.ingredients: Frozen banana, frozen mango, spinach, almond milk, granola, coconut flakes, chia seeds
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Blend frozen banana, mango, spinach, almond milk until thick.
2. Pour into a bowl.
3. Top the dish with a generous layer of granola, coconut flakes, chia seeds. for added flavor and texture
4. Add fresh fruit slices.
5. Serve immediately.
breakfast.health_benefits: Packed with vitamins, fiber-rich, antioxidants from fruits and greens.

breakfast.title: Dosa with Chutney
breakfast.ingredients: Rice and urad dal batter, oil, coconut chutney (coconut, green chili, ginger, tempering)
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Heat tava, pour a ladle of batter, spread thin.
2. Drizzle oil around edges.
3. Cook until crispy and golden.
4. Grind coconut, green chili, ginger for chutney.
5. Temper with mustard seeds and serve.
breakfast.health_benefits: Fermented batter aids digestion, light yet satisfying, good source of carbs.

breakfast.title: Omelette with Vegetables
breakfast.ingredients: Eggs, bell pepper, onion, tomato, spinach, cheese, salt, pepper, olive oil
breakfast.recipe_steps:

2. SautÃƒÂ© diced vegetables in olive oil.
3. Pour egg mixture over vegetables.
4. Add grated cheese on one half.
5. Fold and cook until set. Serve hot.
breakfast.health_benefits: High protein, loaded with vitamins from vegetables, keeps you full longer.

breakfast.title: Ragi Porridge
breakfast.ingredients: Ragi flour (finger millet), jaggery, water, cardamom, milk or almond milk
breakfast.recipe_steps:
1. Mix ragi flour with cold water to a paste.
2. Boil remaining water and add ragi paste.
3. Stir continuously to avoid lumps.
4. Cook for 8-10 min until thick.
5. Add jaggery, cardamom. Serve warm.
breakfast.health_benefits: Rich in calcium and iron, great for bone health, high fiber aids digestion.

lunch.title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
lunch.ingredients:
-  Quinoa (80g dry)
-  Roasted sweet potato (100g)
-  Chickpeas (80g)
-  Kale (40g)
-  Avocado (1/4)
-  Tahini dressing (1 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice
lunch.health_benefits: Quinoa is a complete plant protein with all essential amino acids. Chickpeas add fiber and iron. Kale is a superfood rich in vitamins A, C, and K.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Cook quinoa per package instructions (15-20 mins).
2. Cube sweet potato, toss with oil and roast at 200C for 25 mins.
3. Massage kale with olive oil and lemon juice.
4. Arrange quinoa, sweet potato, chickpeas, kale in a bowl.
5. Top the dish with a generous layer of sliced avocado and drizzle tahini dressing. for added flavor and texture

lunch.title: Rajma Chawal
lunch.ingredients:
-  Rajma / kidney beans (100g, soaked overnight)
-  Basmati rice (80g)
-  Onion (1, diced)
-  Tomato (2, pureed)
-  Ginger-garlic paste (1 tbsp)
-  Rajma masala (1 tsp)
-  Cumin seeds
-  Bay leaf
-  Coriander leaves
lunch.health_benefits: Kidney beans are among the richest plant-based protein and iron sources. Combined with rice, they form a complete protein. High fiber content aids digestion.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Pressure cook soaked rajma until soft (5-6 whistles).
2. Heat oil, add cumin seeds and bay leaf.
3. saute onion until golden, add ginger-garlic paste.
4. Add tomato puree and rajma masala. Cook 5 mins.
5. Add cooked rajma with liquid, simmer 15 mins.
6. Serve over steamed basmati rice with fresh coriander.

lunch.title: Dal Tadka with Rice
lunch.ingredients:
-  Yellow toor dal (80g)
-  Basmati rice (80g)
-  Onion (1/2)
-  Tomato (1)
-  Garlic (3 cloves)
-  Cumin seeds (1 tsp)
-  Dried red chili (1)
-  Turmeric (1/2 tsp)
-  Ghee or oil (1 tbsp)
-  Coriander leaves
lunch.health_benefits: Lentils are one of the best plant protein sources with high iron and folate. Turmeric is a natural anti-inflammatory. Dal-rice is a perfectly balanced meal.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Wash and pressure cook dal with turmeric until soft.
2. Cook basmati rice separately.
3. For tadka: heat ghee, add cumin seeds, dried red chili, garlic.
4. Add chopped onion, saute until golden. Add chopped tomato.
5. Pour tadka over cooked dal, mix and serve with rice.

lunch.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
lunch.ingredients:
-  Firm tofu (150g)
-  Broccoli (80g)
-  Bell pepper (1/2)
-  Soy sauce (1 tbsp)
-  Sesame oil (1 tsp)
-  Ginger (1 tsp, grated)
-  Brown rice (80g cooked)
lunch.health_benefits: Tofu is an excellent plant protein with all essential amino acids. Broccoli is a cruciferous vegetable rich in sulforaphane. Low glycemic meal.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Press tofu and cut into cubes.
2. Stir-fry tofu in sesame oil until golden on all sides.
3. Add grated ginger, broccoli, and bell pepper.
4. Add soy sauce and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
5. Serve over brown rice.

lunch.title: Paneer Butter Masala + Rice
lunch.ingredients:
-  Paneer (120g, cubed)
-  Basmati rice (80g)
-  Tomato puree (100ml)
-  Cashew paste (2 tbsp)
-  Butter (1 tbsp)
-  Cream (2 tbsp)
-  Kasuri methi (1 tsp)
-  Garam masala (1 tsp)
-  Red chili powder (1/2 tsp)
lunch.health_benefits: Paneer is rich in calcium and high-quality casein protein. Tomatoes provide lycopene, a powerful antioxidant. A rich, satisfying meal for muscle recovery.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. saute paneer cubes in butter until light golden, set aside.
2. In same pan, add tomato puree and cook 5 mins.
3. Add cashew paste, garam masala, and chili powder.
4. Add paneer cubes, cream, and kasuri methi.
5. Simmer 5 minutes and serve with steamed rice.

lunch.title: Chole (Chickpea Curry) with Bhature
lunch.ingredients:
-  Chickpeas (150g, soaked overnight)
-  Onion (1, diced)
-  Tomato (2, pureed)
-  Chole masala (2 tsp)
-  Tea bag (for color, optional)
-  Maida flour (100g, for bhature)
-  Yogurt (2 tbsp)
-  Oil for deep frying
lunch.health_benefits: Chickpeas are an excellent source of plant protein and dietary fiber. Rich in manganese and folate. A beloved North Indian dish that's hearty and satisfying.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Boil chickpeas with tea bag until soft, drain and discard bag.
2. saute onion until golden, add tomato puree and chole masala.
3. Add boiled chickpeas, simmer 20 mins until thick.
4. For bhature: knead maida with yogurt, salt, and water. Rest 30 mins.
5. Roll into ovals and deep fry until puffed and golden.

lunch.title: Palak Paneer with Roti
lunch.ingredients:
-  Paneer (100g, cubed)
-  Spinach (200g)
-  Onion (1/2)
-  Garlic (3 cloves)
-  Green chili (1)
-  Cream (1 tbsp)
-  Cumin seeds
-  Whole wheat roti (2)
lunch.health_benefits: Spinach is loaded with iron, folate, and vitamin K. Paneer adds calcium and protein. Together they create one of the most nutritious Indian meals.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Blanch spinach in boiling water 2 mins, cool in ice water.
2. Blend spinach into smooth paste.
3. saute cumin, onion, garlic, and green chili.
4. Add spinach paste, cook 5 mins.
5. Add paneer cubes and cream. Simmer 3 mins.
6. Serve with hot whole wheat roti.

lunch.title: Veg Biryani
lunch.ingredients:
-  Basmati rice (120g)
-  Mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas, potato)
-  Biryani masala (1 tbsp)
-  Yogurt (2 tbsp)
-  Onion (1, sliced)
-  Saffron (pinch) in warm milk
-  Mint & coriander leaves
-  Ghee (1 tbsp)
-  Whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cloves)
lunch.health_benefits: A complete meal with carbs, vegetables, and aromatic spices. Saffron has mood-enhancing properties. Mixed vegetables provide diverse vitamins and minerals.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Soak rice 30 mins, parboil with whole spices until 70% done.
2. saute sliced onion in ghee until caramelized.
3. Cook vegetables with yogurt and biryani masala.
4. Layer: vegetables on bottom, rice on top.
5. Drizzle saffron milk, top with mint and coriander.
6. Cover tightly, cook on low heat (dum) for 20 mins.

lunch.title: Grilled Chicken Salad
lunch.ingredients:
-  Chicken breast (150g)
-  Mixed greens (80g)
-  Cherry tomatoes (6)
-  Cucumber (1/2)
-  Olive oil (1 tbsp)
-  Balsamic vinegar (1 tsp)
-  Feta cheese (20g)
-  Salt, pepper, herbs
lunch.health_benefits: Lean chicken breast is one of the best sources of high-quality protein. Mixed greens provide folate and vitamin K. Olive oil adds heart-healthy fats and polyphenols.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs.
2. Grill on medium-high for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked.
3. Let rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
4. Toss greens, tomatoes, and cucumber with olive oil and vinegar.
5. Top salad with grilled chicken and crumbled feta.

lunch.title: Chicken Biryani
lunch.ingredients:
-  Basmati rice (120g)
-  Chicken (200g, bone-in pieces)
-  Yogurt (3 tbsp)
-  Biryani masala (1.5 tbsp)
-  Onion (2, sliced)
-  Mint & coriander leaves
-  Saffron in milk
-  Ghee (2 tbsp)
-  Whole spices
lunch.health_benefits: A complete protein-rich meal. Chicken provides lean protein and B-vitamins. Aromatic spices like cardamom and cinnamon have anti-inflammatory properties.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and biryani masala for 1 hour.
2. Soak and parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Fry sliced onions until deep golden (birista).
4. Layer: marinated chicken, rice, fried onions, mint, saffron milk.
5. Seal pot with dough, cook on very low heat for 25 mins.
6. Serve with raita.

lunch.title: Fish Curry with Rice
lunch.ingredients:
-  Fish fillets (rohu/pomfret, 200g)
-  Coconut milk (100ml)
-  Tomato (1, chopped)
-  Onion (1, sliced)
-  Mustard seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Curry leaves
-  Turmeric & red chili powder
-  Basmati rice (80g)
lunch.health_benefits: Fish is rich in omega-3 fatty acids for heart and brain health. Coconut milk provides healthy MCT fats. A traditional coastal Indian meal packed with nutrients.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate fish with turmeric and salt for 15 mins.
2. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
3. saute onion, add tomato, turmeric, and chili powder.
4. Pour coconut milk, bring to gentle simmer.
5. Add fish fillets and cook on low heat 10-12 mins.
6. Serve with steamed basmati rice.

lunch.title: Butter Chicken + Naan
lunch.ingredients:
-  Chicken (200g, boneless cubes)
-  Yogurt (3 tbsp)
-  Tomato puree (150ml)
-  Butter (2 tbsp)
-  Cream (2 tbsp)
-  Kasuri methi (1 tsp)
-  Garam masala, red chili, ginger-garlic paste
-  Naan bread (2)
lunch.health_benefits: Chicken provides high-quality lean protein for muscle growth. Tomatoes are rich in lycopene. A crowd-favorite Indian dish that's rich in flavor and protein.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices. Rest 2 hrs.
2. Grill or pan-sear marinated chicken until charred.
3. In a pot, melt butter, add tomato puree and cook 10 mins.
4. Add garam masala, cream, kasuri methi.
5. Add chicken pieces, simmer 10 mins.
6. Serve with hot buttered naan.

lunch.title: Tandoori Chicken with Roti
lunch.ingredients:
-  Chicken legs (2)
-  Yogurt (4 tbsp)
-  Tandoori masala (2 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice (1 tbsp)
-  Ginger-garlic paste (1 tbsp)
-  Red chili powder
-  Oil (1 tbsp)
-  Whole wheat roti (2)
-  Onion rings & lemon wedges
lunch.health_benefits: Yogurt-based marinade tenderizes chicken and aids digestion. High protein, moderate fat. Tandoori cooking retains nutrients without excess oil.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. Mix yogurt, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice.
2. Make deep cuts in chicken, coat with marinade. Rest 4 hours.
3. Bake at 220C for 25-30 mins or grill until charred.
4. Baste with oil halfway through.
5. Serve with roti, onion rings, and lemon wedges.

lunch.title: Lentil Soup with Bread
lunch.ingredients:
-  Red lentils (100g)
-  Carrots (1, diced)
-  Celery (1 stalk)
-  Onion (1, diced)
-  Garlic (2 cloves)
-  Cumin (1 tsp)
-  Vegetable stock (500ml)
-  Crusty bread (1 slice)
lunch.health_benefits: Lentils are one of the best plant-based protein sources. Extremely high in fiber for digestive health. Low in fat and very filling, ideal for weight management.
lunch.recipe_steps:
1. saute onion, carrot, celery, and garlic for 5 minutes.
2. Add lentils, cumin, and vegetable stock.
3. Bring to boil, then simmer for 25 minutes.
4. Blend partially for a creamy texture.
5. Season and serve with crusty bread.

lunch.title: Dal Makhani with Jeera Rice
lunch.ingredients: Black lentils, kidney beans, butter, cream, cumin, rice
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Slow cook lentils with spices. 2. Finish with butter and cream. 3. Serve with cumin rice.
lunch.health_benefits: High protein from lentils and rich complex carbohydrates.

lunch.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
lunch.ingredients: Chicken breast, yogurt, spices, tomato puree, cream
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. 2. Grill. 3. Simmer in tomato cream sauce.
lunch.health_benefits: Excellent source of high-quality protein and metabolism-boosting spices.

lunch.title: Classic Cheeseburger
lunch.ingredients: Beef patty, cheese, bun, lettuce, tomato, pickles
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Grill patty. 2. Add cheese to melt. 3. Assemble in bun with veggies.
lunch.health_benefits: High in protein, iron, and B-vitamins.

lunch.title: Margherita Pizza
lunch.ingredients: Pizza dough, San Marzano tomatoes, mozzarella, fresh basil
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Stretch dough. 2. Spread tomatoes and cheese. 3. Bake at high heat. 4. Add basil.
lunch.health_benefits: Calcium from cheese and antioxidants from tomatoes.

lunch.title: Chicken Fajitas
lunch.ingredients: Chicken breast, bell peppers, onions, tortillas, fajita spices
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Slice chicken and veggies. 2. Stir fry with spices. 3. Serve in warm tortillas.
lunch.health_benefits: High in vitamin C from peppers and lean protein.

lunch.title: Chicken Teriyaki with Rice
lunch.ingredients: Chicken breast, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, rice, broccoli
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Pan fry chicken. 2. Add teriyaki sauce to glaze. 3. Serve over rice with steamed broccoli.
lunch.health_benefits: Lean protein and low fat energy source.

lunch.title: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
lunch.ingredients: Chicken breast, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, feta cheese, olive oil
lunch.recipe_steps: 1. Grill chicken. 2. Chop veggies. 3. Toss with olives, feta, and olive oil dressing.
lunch.health_benefits: Heart-healthy fats, high protein, and hydrating vegetables.

lunch.title: Chole Bhature
lunch.ingredients: Chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic paste, chole masala, maida, yogurt, oil
lunch.recipe_steps:

dinner.title: Stir-Fry Tofu & Vegetables
dinner.ingredients:
-  Firm tofu (150g)
-  Broccoli florets (80g)
-  Bell pepper (1/2)
-  Soy sauce (1 tbsp)
-  Sesame oil (1 tsp)
-  Ginger (1 tsp, grated)
-  Brown rice (80g cooked)
dinner.health_benefits: Tofu is an excellent plant-based protein with all essential amino acids. Broccoli is rich in sulforaphane. Low glycemic dinner option for weight management.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Press tofu and cut into cubes.
2. Stir-fry tofu in sesame oil until golden.
3. Add ginger, broccoli, and bell pepper.
4. Add soy sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes.
5. Serve over brown rice.

dinner.title: Baked Sweet Potato Bowl
dinner.ingredients:
-  Sweet potato (1 large)
-  Black beans (80g)
-  Corn kernels (40g)
-  Avocado (1/4)
-  Lime juice
-  Fresh cilantro
-  Cumin (1/2 tsp)
dinner.health_benefits: Sweet potatoes are rich in beta-carotene and vitamin A. Black beans provide excellent fiber and plant protein. Very filling and nutrient-dense dinner.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Bake sweet potato at 200C for 45 minutes until tender.
2. Heat black beans with cumin and a pinch of salt.
3. Split sweet potato open and fluff the insides.
4. Fill with black beans, corn, and sliced avocado.
5. Squeeze lime and garnish with cilantro.

dinner.title: Roasted Vegetable Soup
dinner.ingredients:
-  Carrots (2)
-  Zucchini (1)
-  Onion (1)
-  Garlic (3 cloves)
-  Vegetable stock (400ml)
-  Olive oil (1 tbsp)
-  Thyme & rosemary
-  Salt & pepper
dinner.health_benefits: Roasting deepens flavor and increases nutrient availability. Low-calorie and highly filling. Perfect light dinner for weight loss goals.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Chop all vegetables, toss with olive oil and herbs.
2. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelized.
3. Transfer to a pot, add vegetable stock.
4. Simmer 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.
5. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.

dinner.title: Mushroom & Spinach Pasta
dinner.ingredients:
-  Penne pasta (100g)
-  Mushrooms (100g, sliced)
-  Spinach (60g)
-  Garlic (3 cloves, minced)
-  Olive oil (1 tbsp)
-  Nutritional yeast (1 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice
-  Chili flakes
dinner.health_benefits: Mushrooms are rich in vitamin D and selenium. Spinach adds iron and folate. Nutritional yeast provides B-vitamins without dairy.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Cook penne al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
2. saute garlic in olive oil, add mushrooms and cook 5 mins.
3. Add spinach, stir until wilted.
4. Toss in cooked pasta with a splash of pasta water.
5. Add nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and chili flakes.

dinner.title: Paneer Tikka Masala
dinner.ingredients:
-  Paneer (150g, cubed)
-  Yogurt (3 tbsp)
-  Tikka masala paste (2 tbsp)
-  Tomato puree (100ml)
-  Cream (2 tbsp)
-  Bell pepper (1/2)
-  Onion (1/2)
-  Kasuri methi
-  Butter (1 tbsp)
dinner.health_benefits: Paneer provides slow-digesting casein protein, ideal for overnight muscle repair. Rich in calcium for bone strength. A satisfying dinner rich in flavor.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt and tikka masala paste, 1 hour.
2. Grill or pan-sear paneer and bell pepper until charred.
3. saute onion in butter, add tomato puree, cook 5 mins.
4. Add grilled paneer, cream, and kasuri methi.
5. Simmer 5 minutes and serve with naan or rice.

dinner.title: Grilled Paneer Salad
dinner.ingredients:
-  Paneer (120g)
-  Mixed lettuce (60g)
-  Cherry tomatoes (6)
-  Red onion (1/4)
-  Olive oil (1 tbsp)
-  Lemon dressing
-  Tandoori spice mix
dinner.health_benefits: Light and protein-rich dinner. Paneer provides casein protein for overnight muscle recovery. Salad greens add fiber and vitamins with minimal calories.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate paneer cubes in tandoori spice with a little yogurt.
2. Grill paneer on high heat for 2-3 minutes per side.
3. Toss lettuce, tomatoes, and onion with lemon dressing.
4. Top salad with grilled paneer.
5. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

dinner.title: Mixed Veg Curry + Chapati
dinner.ingredients:
-  Mixed vegetables (200g: beans, carrot, potato, peas)
-  Onion (1)
-  Tomato (2)
-  Ginger-garlic paste (1 tsp)
-  Garam masala (1 tsp)
-  Turmeric & red chili powder
-  Whole wheat chapati (2)
-  Oil (1 tbsp)
dinner.health_benefits: A balanced dinner with diverse vegetables providing different vitamins. Whole wheat chapati adds fiber and complex carbs. Easy to digest for a good night's sleep.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. saute onion in oil until golden.
2. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 1 minute.
3. Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
4. Add all vegetables with spices and a splash of water.
5. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, 12-15 mins.
6. Serve with hot chapati.

dinner.title: Vegetable Khichdi
dinner.ingredients:
-  Rice (60g)
-  Moong dal (40g)
-  Mixed vegetables (80g)
-  Ghee (1 tbsp)
-  Cumin seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Turmeric (1/4 tsp)
-  Ginger (1/2 inch)
-  Salt & pepper
dinner.health_benefits: Khichdi is the ultimate comfort food and is extremely easy to digest. Rice and dal combine to form a complete protein. Traditional Ayurvedic healing food.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Wash rice and moong dal together.
2. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and ginger.
3. Add rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric, and 3 cups water.
4. Pressure cook for 3 whistles or simmer until mushy.
5. Serve hot with a dollop of ghee and pickle.

dinner.title: Grilled Salmon + Asparagus
dinner.ingredients:
-  Salmon fillet (180g)
-  Asparagus (6 spears)
-  Lemon (1/2)
-  Olive oil (1 tbsp)
-  Garlic (1 clove)
-  Dill (fresh)
-  Salt & pepper
dinner.health_benefits: Salmon is the richest source of omega-3 DHA and EPA. Supports brain function and reduces inflammation. Asparagus provides folate and vitamins A, C, K.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Marinate salmon with olive oil, garlic, dill, salt and pepper.
2. Grill on medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side.
3. Trim asparagus and grill or steam for 3 minutes.
4. Squeeze fresh lemon over fish before serving.
5. Plate together and serve.

dinner.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
dinner.ingredients:
-  Chicken breast (150g, sliced)
-  Broccoli (80g)
-  Snow peas (40g)
-  Soy sauce (1.5 tbsp)
-  Sesame oil (1 tsp)
-  Ginger (1 tsp)
-  Garlic (2 cloves)
-  Brown rice (80g cooked)
dinner.health_benefits: Lean chicken breast provides high-quality protein for muscle recovery. Stir-frying preserves vegetable nutrients. A balanced, low-calorie dinner.
dinner.recipe_steps:
1. Slice chicken breast into thin strips.
2. Heat sesame oil, stir-fry chicken until cooked. Set aside.
3. In same pan, add ginger, garlic, broccoli, and snow peas.
4. Return chicken, add soy sauce, and toss 2 minutes.
5. Serve over brown rice.

dinner.title: Chicken Tikka with Raita
dinner.ingredients:
-  Chicken breast (200g, cubed)
-  Yogurt (3 tbsp)
-  Tikka masala (1.5 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice (1 tbsp)
-  Cucumber raita (100ml)
-  Onion rings
-  Mint chutney
dinner.health_benefits: High-protein, low-carb dinner ideal for weight loss. Yogurt marinade adds probiotics. Grilling retains nutrition while adding smoky flavor.
dinner.recipe_steps:

2. Thread onto skewers.
3. Grill or bake at 220C for 15-18 mins, turning once.
4. For raita: mix yogurt with grated cucumber, cumin, salt.
5. Serve tikka with raita, onion rings, and mint chutney.

3. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato puree, and spices.
4. Cook until oil separates, add water for gravy consistency.
5. Add eggs, simmer 10 mins.
6. Serve with hot chapati.

snack.title: Hummus & Carrot Sticks
snack.ingredients:
-  Hummus (3 tbsp)
-  Carrots (2, cut into sticks)
-  Cucumber (1/2, sliced)
-  Paprika (pinch)
snack.health_benefits: Chickpea-based hummus provides plant protein and fiber. Carrots are rich in beta-carotene for eye health. Low calorie and highly satisfying snack.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Peel and cut carrots into thin sticks.
2. Slice cucumber into rounds.
3. Spoon hummus into a small bowl.
4. Sprinkle paprika on hummus.
5. Serve veggies alongside for dipping.

snack.title: Roasted Chickpeas
snack.ingredients:
-  Chickpeas (150g, cooked)
-  Olive oil (1 tsp)
-  Cumin (1/2 tsp)
-  Paprika (1/2 tsp)
-  Salt
-  Chili flakes (optional)
snack.health_benefits: High in plant protein and fiber. Very low in fat. Crunchy, satisfying snack that curbs cravings without the guilt. Rich in iron and manganese.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Drain and pat chickpeas very dry.
2. Toss with olive oil, cumin, paprika, and salt.
3. Spread on baking sheet in single layer.
4. Bake at 200C for 25-30 minutes until crispy.
5. Let cool completely before eating (they crisp up more).

snack.title: Fruit Salad Bowl
snack.ingredients:
-  Apple (1/2, diced)
-  Banana (1/2, sliced)
-  Orange segments (1/2)
-  Pomegranate seeds (2 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice
-  Honey or agave (1 tsp, optional)
snack.health_benefits: Rich in vitamins C, A, and potassium. Natural sugars provide quick energy without a crash. High water content for hydration. Fiber aids digestion.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Wash and cut all fruits into bite-sized pieces.
2. Combine in a bowl.
3. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over fruits.
4. Drizzle honey or agave if desired.
5. Toss gently and serve immediately.

snack.title: Makhana (Fox Nuts)
snack.ingredients:
-  Makhana / fox nuts (50g)
-  Ghee or coconut oil (1 tsp)
-  Turmeric (pinch)
-  Black pepper (pinch)
-  Rock salt
snack.health_benefits: Makhana is low in calories but rich in protein and calcium. It's a traditional Ayurvedic snack that's anti-aging. Gluten-free and perfect for weight loss.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Dry roast makhana in a pan on low heat for 5-7 minutes.
2. Add ghee or coconut oil and stir well.
3. Sprinkle turmeric, black pepper, and rock salt.
4. Roast for another 2-3 minutes until crisp.
5. Cool and store in airtight container.

snack.title: Sprout Chaat
snack.ingredients:
-  Mixed sprouts (100g: moong, chana)
-  Onion (1/4, finely diced)
-  Tomato (1/2, diced)
-  Green chutney (1 tbsp)
-  Lemon juice
-  Chaat masala (1/2 tsp)
-  Coriander leaves
snack.health_benefits: Sprouts are a powerhouse of enzymes, protein, and vitamins. Sprouting increases nutrient bioavailability by 300-400%. Excellent for digestion.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Boil or steam mixed sprouts until tender (5-7 mins).
2. Cool and transfer to a bowl.
3. Add diced onion, tomato, and green chutney.
4. Squeeze lemon juice and sprinkle chaat masala.
5. Toss and garnish with coriander leaves.

snack.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey
snack.ingredients:
-  Greek yogurt (150g)
-  Honey (1 tbsp)
-  Mixed nuts (1 tbsp, crushed)
-  Cinnamon (pinch)
snack.health_benefits: Greek yogurt is rich in probiotics and protein. Honey has natural antibacterial and soothing properties. Nuts add healthy fats and crunch.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Drizzle honey over the top.
3. Sprinkle crushed mixed nuts.
4. Add a pinch of cinnamon.
5. Cover and chill if necessary, then serve cold as a refreshing and nutritious dish.

snack.title: Paneer Tikka Bites
snack.ingredients:
-  Paneer (100g, cubed)
-  Yogurt (2 tbsp)
-  Tikka masala (1 tsp)
-  Bell pepper chunks
-  Onion chunks
-  Lemon juice
-  Oil for grilling
snack.health_benefits: High-protein snack from paneer with minimal carbs. Yogurt marinade is probiotic-rich. Bell peppers add vitamin C. Perfect pre-workout snack.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Mix yogurt with tikka masala and lemon juice.
2. Toss paneer cubes in marinade, rest 30 mins.
3. Thread paneer, bell pepper, onion onto skewers.
4. Grill on high heat for 3-4 mins per side.
5. Serve hot with mint chutney.

snack.title: Dhokla
snack.ingredients:
-  Besan / gram flour (100g)
-  Yogurt (2 tbsp)
-  Eno fruit salt (1 tsp)
-  Mustard seeds (1/2 tsp)
-  Curry leaves
-  Green chili (1)
-  Sugar (1 tsp)
-  Lemon juice
snack.health_benefits: Steamed snack, no oil used in cooking. Besan is high in protein and fiber. Fermentation from yogurt aids digestion. A guilt-free Gujarati classic.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Mix besan, yogurt, water, turmeric, salt, sugar into smooth batter.
2. Just before steaming, add Eno and mix gently.
3. Pour into greased plate, steam 15 minutes.
4. For tadka: heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chili.
5. Pour tadka over steamed dhokla, cut into squares.

snack.title: Masala Chaas (Buttermilk)
snack.ingredients:
-  Fresh yogurt (100ml)
-  Water (150ml)
-  Cumin powder (1/2 tsp)
-  Mint leaves (4-5)
-  Ginger (small piece, grated)
-  Black salt
-  Coriander leaves
snack.health_benefits: Probiotic-rich for gut health. Aids digestion and cools the body. Virtually no fat. Cumin improves digestion and ginger reduces bloating.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Blend yogurt and water until smooth.
2. Add cumin powder, grated ginger, and black salt.
3. Tear mint and coriander leaves, add to mixture.
4. Stir well.
5. Cover and chill if necessary, then serve cold as a refreshing and nutritious dish over ice.

snack.title: Chicken Wings (Grilled)
snack.ingredients:
-  Chicken wings (6 pieces)
-  Yogurt (2 tbsp)
-  Hot sauce (1 tbsp)
-  Garlic powder (1/2 tsp)
-  Paprika (1/2 tsp)
-  Olive oil (1 tsp)
-  Salt & pepper
snack.health_benefits: High protein snack for muscle recovery. Grilling reduces fat compared to frying. Capsaicin from hot sauce boosts metabolism.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Mix yogurt, hot sauce, garlic powder, paprika, salt.
2. Coat chicken wings in marinade, rest 1 hour.
3. Preheat oven to 220C or heat grill.
4. Bake/grill wings 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
5. Serve hot with celery sticks.

snack.title: Boiled Eggs with Pepper
snack.ingredients:
-  Eggs (2)
-  Black pepper
-  Salt
-  Chaat masala (optional)
snack.health_benefits: One of the most nutrient-dense foods on earth. Rich in complete protein, choline, and vitamin D. Zero prep, portable, and highly satisfying.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Place eggs in a pot, cover with cold water.
2. Bring to boil, then cook for exactly 9 minutes.
3. Transfer to ice water for 5 minutes.
4. Peel and slice in half.
5. Sprinkle salt, pepper, and chaat masala.

snack.title: Chicken Seekh Kebab
snack.ingredients:
-  Chicken mince (150g)
-  Onion (1/4, finely minced)
-  Ginger-garlic paste (1 tsp)
-  Green chili (1, minced)
-  Garam masala (1/2 tsp)
-  Coriander leaves
-  Egg (1, for binding)
-  Oil for grilling
snack.health_benefits: Lean chicken mince is high in protein and low in fat. Spices like garam masala aid metabolism. A flavorful, filling snack without empty carbs.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
2. Shape mixture around metal skewers into long kebabs.
3. Refrigerate 30 minutes to firm up.
4. Grill on medium heat, rotating, for 12-15 minutes.
5. Serve with mint chutney and onion rings.

snack.title: Tuna Salad Cup
snack.ingredients:
-  Canned tuna in water (100g)
-  Celery (1 stalk, diced)
-  Red onion (1 tbsp, minced)
-  Olive oil (1 tsp)
-  Lemon juice (1 tsp)
-  Black pepper
-  Lettuce cups (2)
snack.health_benefits: Tuna is extremely high in lean protein and omega-3 fats. Low calorie and highly satiating. Great for building lean muscle mass.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Drain tuna and flake with a fork.
2. Mix with diced celery, red onion, olive oil, lemon juice.
3. Season with salt and black pepper.
4. Wash and dry lettuce leaves to form cups.
5. Spoon tuna mixture into lettuce cups and serve.

snack.title: Mixed Nuts Trail Mix
snack.ingredients:
-  Almonds (10)
-  Walnuts (5)
-  Cashews (8)
-  Raisins (1 tbsp)
-  Pumpkin seeds (1 tbsp)
-  Dark chocolate chips (1 tsp)
snack.health_benefits: Almonds are rich in vitamin E and healthy fats. Walnuts are the best nut source of omega-3. Dark chocolate provides antioxidants. A balanced energy-boosting snack.
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Combine all nuts and seeds in a bowl.
2. Add raisins and dark chocolate chips.
3. Mix well.
4. Portion into small bags or containers.
5. Store in a cool, dry place for up to 2 weeks.

snack.title: Hummus with Pita & Carrots
snack.ingredients: Chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, pita bread, carrots
snack.recipe_steps: 1. Blend chickpeas, tahini, and lemon. 2. Serve with sliced carrots and pita.
snack.health_benefits: Great source of plant protein and fiber.

snack.title: Masala Chai with Biscuits
snack.ingredients: Tea leaves, milk, ginger, cardamom, sugar, digestive biscuits
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
2. Add tea leaves, simmer 2 min.
3. Add milk, bring to boil.
4. Strain, add sugar.
5. Serve with biscuits.
snack.health_benefits: Ginger and cardamom aid digestion, warming and comforting, boosts alertness.

snack.title: Sprouts Chaat
snack.ingredients: Mixed sprouts, onion, tomato, cucumber, lemon, chaat masala, coriander, green chutney
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Steam or boil sprouts.
2. Dice onion, tomato, cucumber.
3. Mix everything together.
4. Add lemon juice, chaat masala, salt.
5. Garnish with coriander, serve with green chutney.
snack.health_benefits: Excellent plant protein, enzyme-rich sprouts, low calorie, high fiber.

snack.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
snack.ingredients: Whole wheat bread, peanut butter, banana, honey, chia seeds
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Toast bread slices.
2. Spread peanut butter generously.
3. Slice banana and arrange on top.
4. Drizzle honey and sprinkle chia seeds.
5. Serve immediately.
snack.health_benefits: Healthy fats from peanut butter, potassium from banana, sustained energy.

snack.title: Trail Mix
snack.ingredients: Almonds, walnuts, cashews, pumpkin seeds, dried cranberries, dark chocolate chips
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Measure equal portions of nuts and seeds.
2. Add dried cranberries.
3. Toss in dark chocolate chips.
4. Mix well.
5. Store in an airtight container.
snack.health_benefits: Heart-healthy fats, antioxidants from dark chocolate, portable energy.

snack.title: Boiled Egg Salad
snack.ingredients: Boiled eggs, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olive oil, lemon, salt, pepper
snack.recipe_steps:
1. Boil eggs, peel and halve.
2. Arrange on a bed of lettuce.
3. Add sliced tomatoes and cucumber.
4. Drizzle olive oil, lemon juice.
5. Season with salt and pepper.
snack.health_benefits: High protein, low carb, excellent post-workout snack.
